items.title: HFBK Hamburg — PhD in Art Practice (Summer 2027)
items.funding: Semester contribution only. DAAD separate, not automatic.
items.eligibility: Diplom / Meisterschüler / Master with artistic-practical focus.

items.title: Studios at MASS MoCA — July–December 2027 residencies
items.funding: Studio + housing. Aid typically $0–$450 per week if selected.
items.eligibility: Visual artists and writers. International welcome.

items.title: Kerala PSC — Artist (Information and Public Relations)
items.eligibility: Diploma in Drawing and Painting (MGTE/KGTE or equivalent). Age 19–43 with relaxations. Anticipated vacancy.

items.title: IGNOU Assistant Professor — Visual Arts (Painting)
items.deadlineNote: Online 20 Oct 2026 or 30 days after Employment News, whichever later. Hard copy 30 Oct 2026.
items.eligibility: 1 OBC reserved post. Path A: Master's 55% + UGC NET/SET or PhD as per UGC. Path B: traditional/professional artist with Bachelor's and listed professional achievements (AIR/DD A-grade etc.). NET not waived except Path B / PhD rules.
items.howToApply: Online on ignou.ac.in from 20 Sep 2026; post hard copy to ACD, IGNOU.
items.verifyNote: Official Advt. 01/2026/ACD dated 19.09.2026. School of Performing and Visual Arts. NET usually required unless Path B.

items.title: KTET September 2026 — Category 4 (Art & specialist teachers)
items.funding: Exam only. Fee ₹500 general / ₹250 SC-ST-PwD. Not a job appointment.
items.eligibility: Category 4 covers art and craft and other specialist teachers as per General Education Dept qualifications. Confirm own diploma against official brochure before applying.
items.verifyNote: Official window opens 23 Sep 2026. This is TET, not a vacancy.
